description.value: The DoubleTree by Hilton Kamloops is a full-service hotel situated in downtown Kamloops on St Paul Street, close to the Thompson River and the city centre. As part of the Hilton brand, it offers the amenities expected of a mid-to-upper-tier chain hotel in a mid-sized BC city. Kamloops sits at the confluence of major cycling routes in the BC interior, making this a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists passing through.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 35m; rack (1 space) at 82m; rack (10 spaces) at 93m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for all fetched pages returned Hilton CMS error pages ('Something went wrong'), providing no usable amenity or contact information. All amenity fields must therefore rely solely on OSM tags, but per the rules OSM amenity tags are not authoritative without website confirmation, so nearly all amenities are null. The OSM tag internet_access=wlan suggests Wi-Fi but cannot be confirmed from the website; the hotel is a known active Hilton brand property at this Kamloops address with looks_closed=false.
concerns: Website returned Hilton CMS error pages for all fetched URLs — no amenity or contact information could be confirmed from the website. All amenities marked null pending a successful website fetch.
OSM name 'Hilton Doubletree' does not match standard brand styling 'DoubleTree by Hilton'; retained as-is per OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Hilton brand hotel in downtown Kamloops; OSM flags it as open and it is publicly accessible accommodation useful to touring cyclists.
